concept.hr: Poluvalno ostaje valovitost 50 Hz, punovalno 100 Hz; zvučnik je čini brujanjem
concept.en: Half-wave leaves a 50 Hz ripple, full-wave 100 Hz; a speaker makes it a hum

summary.hr: Napon iza poluvalnog i punovalnog ispravljača, s kondenzatorom za punjenje i bez njega: frekvencija i veličina preostale valovitosti, i kako zvuči.
summary.en: The voltage behind a half-wave and a full-wave rectifier, with and without a reservoir capacitor: the ripple's frequency and size, and how it sounds.

what.hr: Aplet applet_brumm.html (brujanje od 50 Hz i 100 Hz) i tekst o preostaloj valovitosti (50ohm.de, odjeljak restwelligkeit, hrvatski prijevod)
what.en: The applet applet_brumm.html (a 50 Hz and a 100 Hz hum) and the text on ripple (50ohm.de, section restwelligkeit, Croatian translation)

changes.hr: Prilagođen simdeck kitu, tekst preveden na engleski, dodani model ispravljača s kondenzatorom za punjenje, crtež napona, AC-vezanje, predlošci i objašnjenje; zvuk se sada računa iz nacrtanog napona
changes.en: Adapted to the simdeck kit, the text translated into English, a rectifier model with a reservoir capacitor, a plot of the voltage, AC coupling, presets and an explanation added; the sound is now computed from the plotted voltage
